subject: poly2nb and nb2INLA adjacency outputting seemingly incorrect neighbor adjacency

messages.author: 5a65c451b9c1795b
messages.subject: poly2nb and nb2INLA adjacency outputting seemingly incorrect neighbor adjacency
parts:
When I attempt to use the poly2nb and nb2INLA functions from the spdep package to get an adjacency matrix from my shapefile:

temp <- poly2nb(shape,row.names = NewOID_, queen = FALSE)
nb2INLA("MENH.graph", temp)

the resulting graph file shows seemingly incorrect adjacencies.  It is as if under the hood the shapefile or the r functions are re-indexing the polygons.  So for example, polygon 1 would not be adjacent to polygon 30, but this is the result I am getting, which could only happen if polygon 30 was somehow renamed or indexed as polygon 2.  In other words, the adjacencies are probably correct, but the way they are indexed in the graph file is undecipherable.

In the poly2nb I was trying to "tell" r the polygon IDs should be NewOID_.  

Is there a way to control sorting and indexing?

Thank you,

Susan
